meta_description:
581 likes, 15 comments - caparaggupta on October 13, 2026: "“AI can draft. But you still sign.”

That was my one big message to the students at Gargi College today.

I was honoured to be on the panel at Cascade ‘26 – En Route: Navigating What Comes Next, organised by The Commerce Association, Gargi College (University of Delhi), in its Diamond Jubilee year.

I shared the stage with Mr. Saurav Shah (CFO, Libas) and Mr. Abhishek Lahiri (VP & Head of Public Policy, Mastercard South Asia). Ms. Lily Prasad (CTO, FSSAI) moderated the session.

My three takeaways for commerce students:

1⃣ The CA qualification is not losing its value. It is shifting from preparation to judgment. AI does the first draft. Accountability still sits with a human.

2⃣ Entry-level work is shrinking. Freshers now need to start thinking like seniors from day one.

3⃣ The underrated skill is the ability to check, not to memorise. Read an annual report. Question a number. Verify what AI tells you.

The students asked sharp, honest questions about AI, careers, and choosing between CA, CFA, and MBA. India’s commerce talent is in good hands.

Thank you to the faculty and the student team @commerceassociation_gargi for the warm hospitality and a brilliantly run event. 🙏

#Cascade26 #GargiCollege #CommerceEducation #CharteredAccountant #caparaggupta".
